content: Also, we compare our results with the baseline being the results when we consider only the similarity between sentences and keywords. The results are shown in Table 1 . Here, both $Sim1$ and $Sim2$ are the mean of similarities of the entire Set. $BaseSim1$ and $BaseSim1$ are computed similar to $Sim1$ and $Sim2$ respectively but with the $t$ value as 1 in Equation 1 . It is evident that the results are better if both similarities ( $S_1(x,y)$ and $S_2(x,y)$ ) are considered.
